item1.title: German Cup Champion! Fan Zhendong Wins MVP in First Overseas Title
item1.excerpt: In the German Cup final, Fan Zhendong's Saarbrücken club defeated their opponent 3:1. Fan Zhendong won all four matches in one day and was named MVP, claiming his first championship since joining the overseas club.

item2.title: National Games Men's Singles Title Successfully Defended, Sixth National Games Gold Medal Won
item2.excerpt: In the 15th National Games men's singles final, Fan Zhendong defeated Lin Shidong 4:1 to successfully defend his title, winning consecutive National Games men's singles championships.

item3.title: First Victory in Bundesliga
item3.excerpt: In the second round of the Bundesliga, Saarbrücken Club defeated巴特柯尼希斯霍芬 Club 3:1 away, and Fan Zhendong achieved his first victory in the Bundesliga.

item4.title: Officially Joined Bundesliga Saarbrücken Club
item4.excerpt: The German Table Tennis Bundesliga club Saarbrücken officially announced the signing of Fan Zhendong to participate in the 2025-2026 Bundesliga and European Champions League seasons.

item5.title: Announced Withdrawal from World Ranking System
item5.excerpt: Fan Zhendong announced his withdrawal from the world ranking system through social media, but explicitly stated that he will not retire and will continue to participate in domestic events and club competitions.

item6.title: Paris Olympics Men's Singles Champion, Achieving Grand Slam Glory
item6.excerpt: In the Paris Olympics table tennis men's singles final, Fan Zhendong defeated Truls Moregard 4:1 to win the gold medal, completing the Grand Slam and achieving the Super Golden Slam.

item7.title: Classic Comeback at Paris Olympics! Defeated Harimoto 4:3 to Reach Semifinals
item7.excerpt: In the Paris Olympics men's singles quarterfinals, Fan Zhendong reversed and defeated Japanese player Tomokazu Harimoto 4:3 after trailing 0:2 and 2:3, staging a stunning comeback.
